research.title: Image Classification Under Blur and Illumination Changes
bullets: Implemented assigned image preprocessing routines for controlled blur and brightness perturbations within an existing image classification evaluation pipeline.
Ran prescribed robustness evaluations, checked label alignment, and summarized classwise prediction changes across clean and perturbed image inputs.

work.title: Inventory and Order Processing Support
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing lists, recorded inventory discrepancies, and routed damaged or missing items for supervisor review.
Prepared order paperwork, maintained filing records, and coordinated collection schedules with staff to support routine daily operations.

projects.title: Color Histogram Baseline for Scene Classification
bullets: Implemented normalized color histogram features and a linear support vector classifier as a baseline for categorizing scene images.
Evaluated held out predictions using confusion matrices and inspected misclassified images to identify limitations of global color representations.
